d.seg: Instagram पे कनेक्ट होगे मेरे साथ?
d.tr: Will you connect with me on Instagram?
d.ctx: The user asks the expert if they can connect on Instagram. The expert responds that she will check.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external social media platform.

d.seg: हाँ हो जाऊँगी, बट मैं आपको जानती नहीं हूँ ना अभी।
d.tr: Yes, I will, but I don't know you yet.
d.ctx: The expert agrees to connect on Instagram but mentions she doesn't know the user yet.
d.j: The expert is agreeing to move the conversation to an external platform.

d.seg: हाँ एक बार देख लो मेरी प्रोफाइल, वहाँ सही लगे तो बात कर लेना वरना ब्लॉक कर देना।
d.tr: Yes, check my profile once, if it seems right there, then talk, otherwise block me.
d.ctx: The user suggests the expert check his profile on Instagram. The expert responds with surprise at his confidence.
d.j: The user is encouraging the expert to check his profile on an external platform to continue the conversation.

d.ctx: The user asks again if the expert will connect on Instagram. The expert agrees but says she wants to know him first.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external social media platform.
